audioNote.markdown:
Agenda Settings are used to customize key parameters for organizing and structuring the various agenda views. 

Day Start Time and Day End Time define the overall start and end times for the event agenda. These settings establish the earliest and latest times that sessions can be scheduled during each event day.

Session Statuses allow event teams to manage and schedule sessions with a variety of statuses—not just those that are accepted.

audioNote.markdown: Session Format and Default Duration allow organizers to assign a default time length to each session format, helping to streamline the scheduling process. For example, if the default duration for the Lightning Talk format is set to 30 minutes, scheduling a session with this format to start at 8:00 AM will automatically set the end time to 8:30 AM.

audioNote.markdown:
Lastly, Room Visibility determines which rooms are displayed when scheduling sessions on the Rooms page. This feature is especially useful for events with a large number of rooms, allowing you to control how many are visible at a time for easier navigation and management.

Once you have configured all of your agenda settings, do not forget to click the save button.
